articles.title: Netanyahu says flight attacker 'underwent Islamist radical indoctrination'
articles.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

articles.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
articles.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

articles.title: K-pop star convicted of violating military service law
articles.description: The member of K-pop band Winner was given a suspended prison sentence for repeated absences from his national service work.

articles.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
articles.description: In total 11 regions of the country were attacked overnight, with residential buildings and railways also targeted, the Ukrainian PM says.

articles.title: Kim Jong Un's sister issues warning as she denies South Korea land mine claims
articles.description: Kim Jong Un's sister has threatened retaliation and said claims North Korea planted land mines that injured three South Korean soldiers are a "conspiratorial farce".
